remarks: Discover this stunning, move-in-ready home in Saugus, offering 3,744 square feet of expansive living space with 5 spacious bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features a versatile upstairs loft, ideal for a media room, as well as a convenient main-level bedroom and full bathroom. This downstairs suite is separated from the open-concept family room and kitchen by a stylish sliding barn door, providing exceptional flexibility for guests or multi-generational living.
